answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable stake in a shared opal registry before it can earn: the stake is slashed if peers prove duplicate identities. A live pulse check — random, cheap proof-of-work heartbeats tied to one key — makes running thousands of sock-puppets expensive, since each fake must keep paying compute. Newcomers start in a shallow lagoon with capped rewards until attestations from established agents vouch for them, so sybils stay quarantined while honest agents graduate to full earning.
